newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Eleven soldiers wounded in Philippine fighting.
newsitem.headline: Eleven soldiers wounded in Philippine fighting.

text.p: Eleven soldiers have been wounded in clashes between army troops and a breakaway Moslem rebel faction in the southern Philippines, a military spokesman said on Wednesday.

The fighting erupted on Basilan island on Tuesday when an army patrol was fired on by rebels of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) and continued sporadically on Wednesday, the spokesman said. There were no confirmed casualties among the guerrillas.

The MILF is a breakaway faction of the mainstream Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF), which signed a peace deal with Manila last month calling for Moslem autonomy in the southern islands. The MILF is demanding an Islamic state.
Officials in Manila said they were holding exploratory talks with MILF leaders on a separate peace deal with them.
Three MILF guerrillas were killed in fighting with government forces also in Basilan last week.
